regions.name: Brahmaputra
regions.quote: More recent records have tended to be from the Brahmaputra river basin in northeastern India and Bangladesh or various parts of Myanmar including Lake Indawgyi as well as the Salween, Thandwe and Ayeyarwady river drainages.
